description: A comment directly after the opening marker does not start a heredoc
notes: The spec's grammar puts a Newline after the opening identifier, and a line comment is equivalent to a newline, so a comment could stand in for it. hashicorp/hcl requires an actual newline right after the identifier (BeginHeredocTmpl in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl) and otherwise doesn't recognize a heredoc, so << becomes two less-than symbols.
